rationale: B01 is an aggregate fair-value completeness flag, but the raw SOI tables show a valid two-measure layout with both Cost and Fair Value columns. Actual investment rows carry fair value cells, and the current schedule reconciles: bank debt fair value 383,948 plus common equity fair value 14,037 equals total investments fair value 397,985. The flagged low leaf coverage is therefore a rule-scope artifact from counting non-fair-value measure leaves such as cost/other structural cells, not a source data omission.
